title: [research/D8 exit-head] POSSIBLE one-bar leak + grid skew in build_exit_head_dataset (UNVERIFIED, read from code 2026-11-20): (1) rows_for_trade takes 'bars strictly before entry' as candles[:bisect_right(open_stamps, t_open)], so if the harness entry_time is the ENTRY bar's open time, the bar that opens AT entry (closes one bar later) is inside atr_entry / vol_entry -> entry-reference features see up to one bar past entry; (2) the builder buckets OPEN-stamped (floor, = native grid) while the scoring side (harness _resample / exit_head_replay, label=right closed=right) uses the phase-shifted grid -> train/score grid mismatch in every trainer exit-head bakeoff.
